sections.name: Decision log stream
sections.description: The live decision-log feed: timestamped mono lines with severity chips on semantic tints (info cool, warn on the warning tint, exactly one brand-tone flag), the newest line fading in on a slow reduced-motion-safe keyframe, and a following-everything-logged footer whose live dot is the view's one phosphor element.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: paneLabel
props.doc: mono caps label on the feed header

props.name: paneMeta
props.doc: mono caps metadata, header end side

props.name: lines
props.doc: the feed; keep exactly one flag-level line, it is the brand-tone budget

props.name: followingLine
props.doc: footer status while following

props.name: pausedLine
props.doc: paused variant only: footer status

props.name: retentionLine
props.doc: footer end-side metadata

sections.name: API quickstart
sections.description: Tabbed shell pane beside a three-step column: curl, TypeScript and Python tabs (aria-pressed), dollar-prefixed request lines, an endpoint mono caption, a copy chip, and a periwinkle-tinted response block in the response-open variant. Ask Alfred from your own tools.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: endpoint
props.doc: mono caption above the request lines

props.name: steps
props.doc: the numbered column beside the pane

props.name: tabs
props.doc: one shell/code specimen per language; prompt lines render the $ prefix

props.name: responseLabel
props.doc: status caption on the response block

props.name: responseLines
props.doc: the response body, one mono line each

props.name: showResponse
props.doc: response-open variant: render the tinted output block

sections.name: Shortcut grid
sections.description: The product as a keyboard map: three instrument cards grouped Ask, Act and Navigate, each row a plain-language action with its Kbd combo, bracketed counts in the card headers, and exactly one highlighted row on the accent tint.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: groups
props.doc: keep exactly one highlighted row across all groups

sections.name: Boot sequence
sections.description: Connecting your stack as a boot log: mono lines checking in one by one with success ticks and per-step timing figures, closing on a ready-in-4m-12s line with the phosphor cursor. The done variant renders the finished log with no animation.

props.name: titleAccent
props.doc: substring of title rendered in the brand gradient; the section's one gradient element

props.name: lines
props.doc: the boot steps, each with its timing figure

props.name: readyLine
props.doc: the closing line the phosphor cursor blinks after

props.name: variant
props.doc: default staggers the lines in; done is the static finished log

sections.name: Man-page FAQ
sections.description: The FAQ styled as a help page: an ALFRED(1) header, NAME, SYNOPSIS and QUESTIONS in mono section headers with hairline rules, a mono command synopsis specimen, and every answer set in Satoshi. Mono labels, body never.

props.name: headerStart
props.doc: man header, start side

props.name: nameBody
props.doc: Satoshi one-liner under NAME

props.name: synopsisLine
props.doc: the mono command specimen; the one code surface of the section

props.name: questions
props.doc: Satoshi questions and answers, hairline-ruled

sections.name: Reasoning replay
sections.description: A reasoning replay: the ConsolePanel transcript of a working session over a static timeline scrubber with step markers, start and end timestamps, and one accent playhead carrying the view's phosphor glow. Scrub back through why the call was made.
